title: stylobasium lineare var. parviflora
intro: Stylobasium lineare var. parviflora, commonly known as the Tasmanian stylobasium, is a plant species in the family Colchicaceae, native to Australia. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Stylobasium lineare var. parviflora is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antiseptic properties, making it a popular remedy for skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
